Overview

Saint Paul is a city in MN with a population of 303,176. Twin Cities’ quieter half with historic architecture, hockey, and Midwest winters. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.5.
